scope: Offline analysis of existing user-authorized logs only; no new hardware or network operations
feature: Separate diagnostic reasons for ambiguous result codes

evidence.finding: Status masked with0x70 becomes0/4; exhausted busy choices and input rejection also produce4, so return4 alone cannot identify a path.
Timeout and a valid received zero both return0; a zero result alone cannot distinguish them.

required_observations: SPI completion or timeout observations if already recorded
Applicable module/version context without publishing UID/VIN/MAC
